# swaybg

The wallpaper: a solid `bg_desktop` color from the palette.

`swaybg.service` reads `~/.config/theme/colors.sh`; `theme set` restarts it.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`swaybg/packages`): `swaybg`

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.config/systemd/user/swaybg.service`

**User units** (enabled by `install.sh --units`): `swaybg.service`

**`reload.sh`** (run by `theme set`): restart swaybg.service, which reads its colors at startup. try-restart leaves a stopped unit alone (a bar hidden with its toggle stays hidden).
